class _StubObject:
  """Permissive stand-in for pymtl names used only as attributes/values."""
  def __init__( self, name = '<stub>' ):
    object.__setattr__( self, '_stub_name', name )
  def __getattr__( self, attr ):
    if attr.startswith( '__' ):

    return _StubObject( f'{object.__getattribute__(self, "_stub_name")}.{attr}' )

  mod.__all__  = list( all_names )

    'pymtl3.extra',
    'pymtl3.passes',
    'pymtl3.passes.backends',
    'pymtl3.passes.backends.verilog',

]

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Permissive stub objects / classes
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _StubObject:
  """Permissive stand-in for pymtl names used only as attributes/values."""
  def __init__( self, name = '<stub>' ):
    object.__setattr__( self, '_stub_name', name )
  def __getattr__( self, attr ):
    if attr.startswith( '__' ):
      raise AttributeError( attr )
    return _StubObject( f'{object.__getattribute__(self, "_stub_name")}.{attr}' )
  def __call__( self, *args, **kwargs ):
    return _StubObject( f'{object.__getattribute__(self, "_stub_name")}()' )
  def __getitem__( self, key ):
    return _StubObject( f'{object.__getattribute__(self, "_stub_name")}[k]' )
  def __setattr__( self, attr, value ):
    object.__setattr__( self, attr, value )
  def __repr__( self ):
    return f'<stub {object.__getattribute__(self, "_stub_name")}>'

class _StubMeta( type ):
  def __getattr__( cls, attr ):
    if attr.startswith( '__' ):
      raise AttributeError( attr )
    return _StubObject( f'{cls.__name__}.{attr}' )
  def __repr__( cls ):
    return f"<stub-class '{cls.__name__}'>"

class _StubBase( metaclass = _StubMeta ):
  def __init__( self, *args, **kwargs ):
    pass
  def __call__( self, *args, **kwargs ):
    return _StubObject( self.__class__.__name__ )

def _make_stub_class( name ):
  return _StubMeta( name, (_StubBase,), {} )

    tree = ast.parse( ( SIM_DIR / pkg / f'{mod}.py' ).read_text() )

      if isinstance( node, ast.Name ):
        names.add( node.id )
      elif isinstance( node, ast.Attribute ) and isinstance( node.value, ast.Name ):
        names.add( node.value.id )
  names.discard( 'BUILD_TAG' )
  return sorted( names )

  [ f'Bits{n}' for n in ( 2, 3, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 ) ]
  + [ f'b{n}'  for n in ( 2, 3, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 ) ]
  + [ 'Component', 'ElaboratedComponent', 'VerilogPlaceholder',

      'Wire', 'Mux', 'concat', 'sext', 'zext', 'clog2', 'update', 'delayed',

  builtin_names = set( dir( builtins ) )

    if n in builtin_names or n in DENYLIST:
